questions.question: What is the primary goal of Explainable AI (XAI)?
options: To make AI models train faster
To reduce the size of datasets
To help humans understand why AI made a particular decision

questions.question: Why is explainability especially important in medical AI systems?
options: Doctors need to trust and understand the reasoning behind predictions

questions.question: An AI system rejects a loan application but cannot explain why. This situation illustrates the problem of:
Which statement best describes a 'black-box' AI model?
options: A model that uses only numerical data
A model whose internal reasoning is difficult for humans to understand
A model that cannot make predictions

questions.question: Feature importance refers to:
options: The number of features in a dataset
How strongly each feature influences a model's prediction
The order in which features are collected

questions.question: A house-price prediction model considers location more influential than the number of bedrooms. This is an example of:
Why is feature importance useful?
options: It helps explain which inputs contributed most to a prediction

questions.question: An AI predicts that a student will pass an exam mainly because of attendance and previous scores. Attendance and previous scores are:
Which feature would likely have high importance in a model predicting whether it will rain?
What does fairness in AI primarily aim to achieve?
options: Equal and unbiased treatment of individuals or groups

questions.question: An AI hiring system consistently favors one gender despite equal qualifications. This is an example of:
Why can biased training data lead to unfair models?
options: The model learns patterns, including unfair ones, from the data
The model ignores the training data

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a fairness concern?
options: A model takes too long to train
A recommendation system uses too much memory
A credit approval model unfairly rejects applicants from a specific region
A model uses too many features

questions.question: Why is explainability often connected to fairness?
options: Understanding a model's decisions can help identify unfair behavior
Only explainable models can be trained

questions.question: A healthcare model gives different recommendations to identical patients because of their ethnicity. This indicates:
Which statement about feature importance is TRUE?
options: Some features may have little or no effect on predictions.
Feature importance exists only in regression models.

questions.question: An AI model predicts loan defaults. Income has very high importance, while favorite color has almost no importance. This suggests:
options: The model has learned meaningful relationships
The model cannot explain its predictions

questions.question: Which question is MOST related to explainable AI?
options: How many GPUs were used for training?
Why did the model classify this email as spam?

questions.question: A university uses an AI system for admissions. To ensure responsible AI, administrators should be concerned about:
options: Both explainability and fairness of decisions

questions.question: Which sequence best represents responsible AI development?
options: Build model → Analyze feature importance → Check fairness → Deploy
